value.rationale: The sixth branch point is the natural moduli parameter of the genus-two Jacobian compactifying a cotangent level. Identifying it uniformly closes an explicit source-level gap, turns an abstract Kummer-type statement into a fiberwise geometric label, and identifies the sixteen punctures as two-torsion. This is a structural clarification of the entire smooth part of the fibration rather than an arbitrary special-case computation.
